title: Dasmariñas police: ‘No factual basis’ to reports of alleged mass shooting
summary: LUCENA CITY — Police in Dasmariñas City at Cavite have dismissed as false a viral social media report claiming that a mass shooting at a local university on Thursday (October 1) left one person dead.…

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Police in Dasmariñas City at Cavite have dismissed as false a viral social media report claiming that a mass shooting at a local university on Thursday (October 1) left one person dead. “The reported alleged mass shooting incident was thoroughly verified and investigated by the investigation section of this station,” the Dasmariñas City police said in a statement posted on Facebook shortly before noon. The police probe “revealed no factual basis to substantiate the reported incident.” Police urged the public to refrain from sharing or reposting unverified information that could cause unnecessary alarm and confusion.
